**Observation Log:**

[FACT] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 10:33  
[EVENT] Tommy and Mark walked through a town, experiencing its old-fashioned buildings and unique cars.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tommy looked around in amazement as they walked through the town, trying to take everything in.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tommy had never seen buildings like these before, with their old-fashioned brick facades and ornate metalwork.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The cars looked different, with their boxy shapes and bright, bold colors.  
[EVENT] Tommy and Mark passed by a group of teenagers loitering on the corner, smoking cigarettes and wearing leather jackets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] One of the teenagers sneered, "Hey, check out the new kids," taking a drag from his cigarette.  
[EVENT] Tommy and Mark quickened their pace, feeling uncomfortable under the hostile stares of the group.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mark whispered, "Let's get out of here," tugging on Tommy's arm.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tommy felt a sense of unease as he realized how different this world was from his own.  
[EVENT] Tommy and Mark stumbled upon a group of kids playing a game of stickball in the street.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tommy asked one of the kids, "Hey, what's that game called?"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The kid replied, "It's called stickball, stupid," before turning back to the game.  
[EVENT] Tommy felt embarrassed at being called stupid but was determined to learn about this new world.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tommy noticed the contrast between the carefree world of the stickball game and the harsh realities of the town.  
[EVENT] Tommy realized there was danger lurking around every corner and that they needed to be careful to survive.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tommy and Mark encountered a group of boys who bullied them, using insults related to their masculinity and relationship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] One bully shouted, "Hey, what are you two queers doing here?"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Another bully taunted, "Where do you think you're going, little girl?"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A bully grabbed Tommy's shirt, saying, "What's the matter, princess? You and your boyfriend scared?"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mark tried to defend them, saying, "Hey, we're just passing through. No need to get all worked up."
